dog.description_text:
Like a flower ready to bloom, Maggie is finally opening up and letting the sun shine through. This beautiful but shy 11-year old tortoiseshell cat has exquisite markings, stunning eyes, and a soft velvety coat.

Maggie is cautious around humans, but slowly coming out of her shell. In the morning, she will rub up against your leg, purring and meowing, as she patiently waits for her breakfast to be served. She allows petting, caressing, and scratching…but as with many cats, affection is on HER terms. OK, we get it, Mags…you call the shots!

Maggie gets along well with other cats, but she’d definitely be more comfortable in a household without dogs. They scare her! Woof woof, no bueno!

Maggie is litter-box trained and takes excellent care of her personal space, as well as her thick lush coat. She may not be the most outgoing kitty you’ll ever meet, but she’s special in her own way, and the more intimately you know her, the more you’ll see her sweet nature and her kind soul.

If you would like to adopt this wonderful cat, please email rescue@pupstarzrescue.org or visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
